description: Four sheets containing notes and adding machine tapes found together labeled, "1953" [Multiple sheets stapled together were moved to Los Luceros – Oversize Box 2 – "Bookkeeping …"- Box 29]. Sixteen sheets containing records, notes, and adding machine tapes found together labeled, "1954" [Two sheets of advertising moved to Los Luceros – Oversized Box 2 – "Bookkeeping …"- Box 29]. No records found for 1955. Fourteen sheets containing records, notes, adding machine tapes found labeled, "1956". Ten sheets of records and receipts dated 1957 found in various files. Eighteen sheets containing: a letter from Oliver Seth to Maria Chabot, Dec. 19, 1958; fifteen pages of the Los Luceros ledger for 1957; and two adding machine tapes. Sixteen sheets containing records, receipts and notes, dated 1958 and one letter from MC to Mrs. Kephart, Jan 29, 1958. Sixteen sheets containing records, receipts, notes, and adding machine tapes, dated 1959 and two letters: MC to Oliver Seth, Jan.26, 1959; MC to Kenneth Foster, July 5, 1959. Six sheets containing: notes; an attorney's bill; three inventories, dated 1960.
title: Bookkeeping, taxes, expenses
